methods.name: Group regional GLM
methods.purpose: Group comparison and continuous age association with optional covariates after native DKT parcel summaries

conditions.statement: Every design column exists and is nonempty; effect has one estimable coefficient
At least two independent subjects per effect level and positive residual degrees of freedom
Same-subject hemisphere mesh bindings and shared atlas/species declarations
Report design-based minimum detectable standardized effect and its approximations
Report FDR family, exclusions and site/scanner composition

steps.statement: Summarize each subject with parcel_summary, then fit one OLS per region with intercept and declared terms; two-sided t test.
BH across all fitted partitions, both hemispheres and selected metrics together.

methods.scope_note: Project registered implementation, not expert-reviewed biological validity; native meshes may differ across subjects, within-subject bindings must agree.

nodes.name: Every design column exists and is nonempty; effect has one estimable coefficient
At least two independent subjects per effect level and positive residual degrees of freedom
Same-subject hemisphere mesh bindings and shared atlas/species declarations
Report design-based minimum detectable standardized effect and its approximations
Report FDR family, exclusions and site/scanner composition

sources.text: Project implementation note: group models bind a subject design and an explicit contrast. This regional method uses native-atlas subject summaries and an additive intercept model; it does not reproduce the tutorial vertexwise DODS pipeline.

Project policy: apply Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment to every fitted regional p value across both hemispheres and all selected metrics in one family. Skipped regions are retained as rows and excluded from that family.
